voice:
Audience: independent coffee shop owners.
Posts go out from the company page; the founder reshares from their personal profile with a short note.
Warm and specific. Real details, nothing generic.
No em dashes, no buzzwords, 0-2 hashtags.
Keep links out of most posts.
Vary length and format; a carousel now and then.

posts.topic: The first pour of the day
posts.body:
The first pour of the day is always for the team.

Before the doors open, before the grinder warms up for real, someone pulls a shot and everyone tastes it. If it's off, we fix it before a customer ever sees it.

What's the small ritual your shop can't skip?
posts.shareNote: Five minutes that saves the whole morning.

posts.body:
Our best barista knows 40 regulars by order, not by name.

Oat flat white, extra hot. Cortado, no sugar, in a glass. It sounds small. It's the reason those 40 people come back.

posts.topic: Why we roast in small batches
posts.body:
We roast in 12 kilo batches. It's slower and it costs more.

It also means we can taste every batch before it ships, and that's the whole point.
